aiResearchSummary.text: Prefect is researching workflow visualization techniques and state change for workflow automation to enhance orchestration of data tasks. In workflow visualization techniques, a graphical user interface renders an origin node with concentric rings of task nodes to visualize execution. In state change for workflow automation, an orchestration engine manages transitions between workflow states. A system and method for the remote execution of one or more arbitrarily defined workflows enables cloud based workflow administration. Together these efforts target visualization, state management and remote execution.
